description: RESIDUAL PLATEAU ISSUE (2026-07-03). After the full parity push (visual 15.3%->72.8%, parity 0->8/33, structural 99%), the last remaining large real layout defect is subgraphs_styled rendering 1452px wide vs reference 1102px (data_collection now essentially matched at 1356 vs 1339 after the membership fix b86b2934). Two independent deep investigators + a fix agent verified selkie's Brandes-Kopf conflict detection, vertical_alignment, ordering (build_layer_graph/sort_subgraph/add_subgraph_constraints/init_order), and border-node ranks/orders are ALL faithful transliterations of dagre. The subgraph-membership first-wins bug (mermaid makeUniq) was found and fixed (b86b2934), which corrected data_collection and clippy_fix. The subgraphs_styled residual is a subtle multi-cluster compound-feed compaction gap that survives even with reference-correct node orders; candidate: se-32e0d6dc (buildLayerMatrix collision for out-of-span dummies). Low ROI: fractional SSIM per unit effort. FLOW-3.3 edge-routing issues are proven inherited 1:1 from node placement (zero pure routing defects) so they clear only as this closes.
